objective: Test CR-preserving overfetch/drop shaping using existing unselected resident expert pages, without changing sealed v1 or stream-burst outputs.
operation: Replace a selected full useful wave by two waves containing its first k and remaining4-k useful pages in original consume order; physically read each missing plane from a unique unselected expert page in the same resident block, and conditionally drop before ECC.

dummy_address_rule.expert: one of the58 unselected resident experts; no duplicate physical address

storage_capability: One read plus one cache weight latch per plane; other two latches remain inputs. No new weight copies, FIFO, cache/read mux, or retained CR bias over an idle interval.
conditional_controls: drop unselected pages before ECC with zero extra control gap
controls: packed adjacent and spaced ordinary same-WL keep-hot/drop using the same capability set
selection: Among feasible schedules choose lowest makespan, then fewest added physical waves, then lexicographic original split indices/prefix counts. API selector must not claim unmodeled hardware support.
certificates: identical useful page ID and consume-order sequence
dummy addresses correspond to unselected resident weights
all physical planes read in every wave
interpretation: If any13wave candidate is feasible at copy500ns, the12wave full-useful model lower bound makes13 wavecount-optimal only within this contract; no general queue theorem or unconditional native support claim.
